raw: “I felt proud when I repaired a desk lamp. There was a loose wire inside the plug, and when I tested it for the first time after fixing it, the light was steady. That’s the bit I remember—the light staying on, and thinking, ‘I did that.’ A little wire, but it made all the difference. You look at a lamp and notice the light, not what’s inside the plug. I liked knowing I’d found the problem and put it right.”
